title: Safar
tagline: Trip planning and travel booking app built in Flutter.
overview: Safar ("travel" in Arabic) is a trip planning app that lets users browse travel options and organize their bookings in one place.
problem: Users planning trips were juggling multiple sources of information across chats and screenshots, with no single place to track bookings and itineraries.
solution: A Flutter app centralizing trip browsing, booking details, and itinerary organization into a single, structured interface.
architecture: Flutter app with local and remote data sources for trip options, structured around a clear itinerary model that groups bookings by trip.
challenges: Designing an itinerary data model flexible enough for different trip types without becoming overly complex
lessonsLearned: Travel apps live or die on how well they organize information under time pressure — clarity beats feature count
futureImprovements: Offline access to itineraries while traveling
results: Working trip planning app consolidating bookings into a single itinerary view
